name: Vietnamese Women's Museum
nameVi: Bảo tàng Phụ nữ Việt Nam
summary: Walk the galleries at 36 Ly Thuong Kiet. The museum is open 8:00 to 17:00 every day. An adult ticket is 40,000 VND. Students and Women’s Union members pay 20,000 VND. Children and school pupils pay 10,000 VND.
getThere: 36 Ly Thuong Kiet. Minutes from Hoan Kiem are check on arrival.
heroCaption: The museum front at 36 Ly Thuong Kiet

notice.title: Open every day
notice.body: The visit page prints 8:00 to 17:00 every day. Do not assume a Monday closing from another museum.

body: The visit is the galleries at 36 Ly Thuong Kiet, south of Hoan Kiem. Give it a morning. The minutes inside were not published. Check on arrival.

The museum prints 8:00 to 17:00 every day. An adult pays 40,000 VND. University and vocational students and Women’s Union members pay 20,000 VND. Children and school pupils pay 10,000 VND. Vietnam Tourism prints the same adult price and the same hours. The walk from Hoan Kiem has no published minute count.

figures.caption: The fashion display inside the galleries
figures.alt: Women's fashion on mannequins in a gallery of the Vietnamese Women's Museum

gettingThere: The address is 36 Ly Thuong Kiet. Walk south from Hoan Kiem Lake. No minute count was on the visit page. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hoan Kiem
legs.body: Walk south to 36 Ly Thuong Kiet. The minutes are check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed on the visit page.
